content_sections.heading: ESIC Empanelment of Advocates 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The Advocate should hold a Bachelor's Degree in Law from a recognized University in India. The Advocate should be enrolled/registered as an Advocate with the Bar Council of India or a State Bar Council. The Advocate should have an office at the place where empanelment is sought, with adequate infrastructure (accessible office, chambers, library, manpower, etc.) and excellent communication skills. The Regional Director, ESIC RO-Maharashtra, may relax the prescribed experience or specify any additional qualification or condition as deemed fit.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Empanelment of Advocates 2026 Fee Schedule
content_sections.text: No application fee is mentioned for submitting the empanelment application. The professional fee payable to empanelled Advocates for handling ESIC's cases is as prescribed by ESIC vide Office Memorandum No. T-11/15/2/2016-Vol-II/T-11/15/12/2016-Vol-II dated 25.03.2026; the exact fee amounts are not specified in this notification and applicants must agree to this fee schedule as part of their undertaking. No retainer fee is paid to any Panel Advocate merely for being empanelled.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Panel Advocate Tenure
content_sections.text: The panel is ordinarily constituted for a period of 3 years (2026–2029), in the interest of continuity and stability. The panel can be discontinued before expiry of the term for reasons recorded in writing, and the process for constituting a new panel is started before expiry of the existing one. If a panel is reconstituted before the existing one expires, the existing panel continues until the new panel is constituted, so that ongoing litigation is not affected; the tenure of the existing panel may also be extended until the new empanelment process is completed.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Empanelment of Advocates 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted in the prescribed format only (Annexure-II for fresh applicants, Annexure-III for existing panel Advocates); no other format will be entertained. ESIC reserves the right to shortlist applications based on the requirement and the number of applications received. Fulfilling the eligibility criteria alone does not confer any right to be called for interaction or selected. Shortlisted Advocates may be called for further interaction before empanelment is finalized. No TA/DA is admissible for attending such interaction. The Selection Committee consists of the Regional Director, ESIC RO-Maharashtra, and two external members of eminence from the legal field. Date, time, venue, and mode of interaction will normally be communicated by e-mail or letter; SMS may be used as an additional mode of communication in exceptional circumstances. Applicants may be required to bring original documents at the time of interaction. Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification, and the candidature of such applicants will be cancelled forthwith. The decision of ESIC regarding shortlisting and selection of candidates is final. The list of selected Advocates will be published on the ESIC website, https://romaharashtra.esic.gov.in, and selected Advocates may separately be issued electronic or written communication confirming empanelment. The application for empanelment does not confer any right or assurance of being empanelled on the ESIC panel.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Empanelment of Advocates 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: Advocates must furnish the following documents along with the application form: Copy of Law Degree and other qualifications Copy of Registration Certificate issued by the Bar Council Copy of Identity Card issued by the Bar Association Copy of ID Proof Copies of Empanelment Letter(s) issued by other Authorities/entities in favour of the Advocate, if any Resume with a brief profile of experience, background, education, list of clients, and nature of cases dealt with Two recent colour passport-size photographs Copy of Income Tax Returns for the last two financial years Copy of Aadhaar Card Copy of PAN Card Undertaking and declaration regarding conflict of interest

content_sections.heading: Key Terms, Duties and Conditions of Empanelment
content_sections.text: Empanelment confers only a right to be considered for legal work and does not bind ESIC to award work to any empanelled Advocate at any time. Allocation of cases is at the sole discretion of authorized ESIC Officers; empanelled Advocates must handle cases themselves and must not delegate them. Empanelled Advocates cannot use ESIC's name, logo, or designations such as "Legal Advisor of ESIC" on their letterhead, signboard, or other materials, and cannot represent themselves as ESIC's Standing Advocate unless specifically authorized. Advocates must act only on ESIC's instructions, report on the proceedings of every hearing, and furnish copies of court orders, failing which ESIC may not settle bills. Advocates must not seek adjournments unless ESIC deems it necessary; unattended matters are treated as a serious violation that may lead to de-empanelment. Performance of each empanelled Advocate is subject to periodical review, and strict confidentiality of ESIC's cases must be maintained. Advocates cannot advise any party against ESIC or accept any case against ESIC during their empanelment. Advocates retain the right to private practice, provided it does not conflict with their duties as an empanelled Advocate. Grounds for cancellation of empanelment include: furnishing false information, failing to attend hearings without sufficient reason, acting against ESIC's instructions, threatening or abusing ESIC staff, leaking case information to opposing parties, seeking frequent adjournments, frequent absence from proceedings, and poor performance as assessed by ESIC RO-Maharashtra. ESIC may terminate an Advocate's empanelment with one month's written notice without assigning any reason; an Advocate may apply for termination by giving three months' notice. ESIC reserves the right to accept or reject any application without assigning any reason, and to postpone or cancel the entire empanelment process at its sole discretion.

faq.question: Q1. What is ESIC Empanelment of Advocates 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification from ESIC, Regional Office-Maharashtra, inviting applications from practicing Advocates for empanelment as Panel Counsel to represent ESIC before the High Court of Bombay and various other courts and tribunals in Maharashtra, for the period 2026–2029.

faq.question: Q2. How many empanelment positions are available under ESIC Empanelment of Advocates 2026?
faq.answer: An indicative total of 366 positions are listed across all courts/tribunals in Maharashtra, though ESIC states this figure may change as per requirement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ESIC Empanelment of Advocates 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications at ESIC, Regional Office-Maharashtra, is 28th August 2026, up to 1700 hours.

faq.question: Q4. What is the eligibility for ESIC Empanelment of Advocates 2026?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Bachelor's Degree in Law and be enrolled with the Bar Council of India or a State Bar Council, along with minimum court practice experience (as on 01.07.2026) ranging from 5 years (EI Court/MM Court) to 10 years (High Court/CAT and other Courts/Tribunals).

faq.question: Q5. What is the fee schedule for ESIC Empanelment of Advocates 2026?
faq.answer: The fee payable to empanelled Advocates is as prescribed by ESIC vide OM No. T-11/15/2/2016-Vol-II/T-11/15/12/2016-Vol-II dated 25.03.2026. The exact fee amounts are not specified in this notification; no retainer fee is paid merely for empanelment.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for ESIC Empanelment of Advocates 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible Advocates must fill the prescribed Annexure-II (fresh applicants) or Annexure-III (existing panel Advocates) application form, attach the required documents, and send it to the Regional Director, ESIC, Regional Office-Maharashtra, Mumbai, before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for ESIC Empanelment of Advocates 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are shortlisted at ESIC's discretion; shortlisted Advocates may be called for an interaction before a Selection Committee comprising the Regional Director and two external legal experts. ESIC's decision on shortlisting and selection is final.

faq.question: Q8. What is the tenure of the ESIC Maharashtra Advocate panel?
faq.answer: The panel is ordinarily constituted for 3 years, covering the period 2026–2029, though it can be discontinued, extended, or reconstituted earlier for recorded reasons.
